text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Here's a Pearl question for you.<n>Who's the biggest
lover of regional<n>bento in the world? That's right,
me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Second Pearl question! Who<n>requested the school
store to stock<n>regional bento? That's right, me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Last one! When the buyer insisted<n>"regional bento
should be eaten in<n>their home regions," who made
them<n>see the error of their ways? That's<n>right, me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Eat the regional bento, know the<n>region. I showed
them a whole new<n>world of bento. Heh, our souls
came<n>to an understanding.
